'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Nick Reisch DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Have Gun, Will Travel!. Upright scan extract/day2_upright/d2p3_p13.png (source page inverted in Part 3). Header Nick Reisch-DS 'Have Gun, Will Travel'. Objective expanded to Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration. Cloud City Prison (V) as written (no matching title; not invented as Security Tower). Carbon Chamber Console (V) → Carbonite Chamber Console (V). Breached Defenses & Molitor → Molator. Ni Chuba Na (V) → Ni Chuba Na?? (V). We'll Let Fate Decide (V) → We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh? (V). After Her (V) → After Her! (V). Darth Vader, Betrayer → Betrayer Of The Jedi. Shield block has a 16th line Blaster Rifle (V) already in reserve; omitted from shields. Voyeur listed as two lines (not (x2)). Reserve qty 60 excluding shields. No wiki dest: Cloud City Prison (V).
